Implemented the focused repair in [sampling.py](/workspace/task/source/src/poliastro/twobody/sampling.py:150).

Root cause: `TrueAnomalyBounds` correctly generated Cartesian states for each sampled true anomaly, but assigned the wrong epochs. Given:

- source periapsis-relative time \(t_{p,0}\)
- sampled periapsis-relative time \(t_{p,i}\)

the time of flight is:

\[
\Delta t_i = t_{p,i} - t_{p,0}
\]

The pre-fix code added these values instead, pairing each valid state with an epoch belonging to a different point in the orbit. The repair changes:

```python
orbit.epoch + (orbit.t_p + delta_ts)
```

to:

```python
orbit.epoch + (delta_ts - orbit.t_p)
```

This restores the documented meaning of an `Ephem`: a time-indexed sequence of coordinates representing the same two-body motion.
